title: Slovakian Ssäm
description: A twist on traditional Korean BBQ, this recipe combines the flavors of Slovakia with the convenience of a ssäm.

ingredients.name: Slovakian sausage
ingredients.notes: Look for a vegetarian alternative if needed

ingredients.name: Ssam wrap
ingredients.notes: You can also use traditional Korean rice cakes

ingredients.name: Nutty slaw
ingredients.notes: Shredded carrots and cabbage with a hint of caraway seeds

ingredients.name: Wrap spread
ingredients.notes: A mixture of sour cream and chopped fresh dill

instructions: 1. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
2. Slice the Slovakian sausage into 1/4-inch thick rounds.
3. Grill the sausage for 2-3 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
4. Meanwhile, toast the ssäm wraps by grilling them for 30 seconds to 1 minute.
5. Assemble the ssäm by spreading a layer of wrap spread on each wrap, followed by a few slices of sausage, some nutty slaw, and a dollop of clotted cream.
6. Drizzle the gooey cheese over the top of each ssäm.
